lines.text: Many learners say: The gate is change?
Pause and guess. What sounds right?
Say: Excuse me, has the gate changed?
For a new change, ask: has it changed?
Now at normal speed: Excuse me, has the gate changed?
Quiz: Excuse me, blank the gate changed? Has, or is? Comment below.
